q: What is the correct passive form of: "The manager satisfied the board members."?
o: The board members were satisfied with the manager.
The board members were satisfied from the manager.
The board members were satisfied at the manager.
The board members were satisfied the manager.

q: Identify the right passive voice of ‘‘What he has done will save his family’’.
o: What he has done will be saved by his family.
His family will have been saved by what he has been done
His family will have been saved by what he has done
His family will be saved by what he has done.

q: Change into passive voice: Order me some food.
o: Let me be ordered some food.
Some food is ordered me.
Some food orders me.
Let some food be ordered for me.
e: এটি আদেশসূচক বাক্য, তাই Passive-এ Let দিয়ে শুরু হয়। বাক্যে দুটি object আছে: indirect object me এবং direct object some food। Passive করার সময় direct object-টি subject হিসেবে বসে, আর indirect object-এর আগে for বা to যুক্ত হয়। তাই Order me some food হয়ে যায় Let some food be ordered for me। আরেকটি উদাহরণ: Buy me a pen হবে Let a pen be bought for me।

q: Choose the correct passive voice: Active: He hanged himself.
o: He hanged himself by himself.
Himself was hanged by him.
He was hanged by himself.
He was been hanged.

q: The company is going to hire new employees. (Make it passive)
o: New employees are going to hired by the company.
New employees will be hired by the company.
New employees will going to hire by the company.
New employees are going to be hired by the company.

q: Identify the correct passive form. He recommended using bullet proof glass.
o: He recommended that we should use bullet proof glass.
Bullet proof glass should be used by him.
He recommended that bullet proof glass should be used.
Using bullet proof glass is recommended by him.

q: People say that failure is a stepping stone to success. (Make it passive)
o: It is said that failure is a stepping stone to success.
It is said by the people that to success failure is a stepping stone.
It is said that by the people that failure is a stepping stone to success.
It is said it is a failure that is a stepping stone to success.

q: Choose the correct passive voice: Why did your sister make such a mistake?
o: Why such a mistake was made by your sister?
Why did such a mistake your sister made by?
Why was this mistake made by your sister?
Why was such a mistake made by your sister?

q: Did he respect the elderly people? (Make it passive)
o: Were the elderly people respected by him?
Was the elderly people respected by him?
Did the elderly people be respected by him?
Did the elderly people respected by him?

q: The passive form of the sentence, “Who wrote this letter?” is -
o: By whom this letter was written?
By whom had this letter been written?
By whom was this letter written?
Who was this letter written by whom?

q: I know that he stole my pen. (Make it passive)
o: It is known to me that he stole my pen.
I know that my pen was stolen by him.
It is known to me that my pen was stolen by him.
All of these

q: She is going to start a new job. (Make it passive.)
o: A new job is going to being started by her.
A new job is going to be started by her.
A new job was going to be started by her.
A new job is going to been started by her.

q: The rose smells sweet. (Make it passive)
o: The rose is smelt sweet.
The rose is sweet when it smelt.
The rose is sweet as it is smelt.
The rose smelt sweet.

q: Who is knocking at the door? (make it passive)
o: By whom is the door being knocked at?
By whom is the door knocked at?
By whom is being the door knocked at?
By whom was the door being knocked at?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রশ্নবোধক active বাক্যকে passive করতে By whom দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়, তারপর tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb, active-এর object (the door) এবং মূল verb-এর past participle। Is knocking চলমান বর্তমান কাল, তাই passive-এ is being knocked। ক্রিয়াটি group verb বলে শেষে at থাকে। ফলে By whom is the door being knocked at শুদ্ধ।

q: Chocolate tastes sweet. (make it passive)
o: Chocolate is taste sweet.
Chocolate is sweet when it tastes.
Chocolate is sweet when it is tasted.
Sweet is the tastes of chocolate.

q: Who taught you typing? (Change the voice.)
o: By whom were you taught typing?
By whom you have taught typing?
By whom have you taught typing?
By whom you taught typing?
e: Who দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া active বাক্যকে passive করতে By whom দিয়ে শুরু করতে হয়, তারপর tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb, active-এর object (এখানে you) এবং মূল verb-এর past participle বসে। Who taught you typing অতীত কালের, তাই By whom were you taught typing। Have you taught বা you taught-এর মতো রূপ গঠন বা কাল দুদিক দিয়েই অশুদ্ধ।

q: A new park _______ next to the school.
o: being developed
is developing
is being developed
developing
e: পার্কটি নিজে কাজ করছে না, বরং পার্কের ওপর উন্নয়নের কাজ চলছে, তাই বাক্যটি passive voice। এই মুহূর্তে চলমান কাজ বোঝাতে Present Continuous passive বসে: is/are being + past participle। পার্ক singular, তাই is being developed শুদ্ধ। এতে বোঝা যায় কাজ এখন চলছে এবং কে করছে তা গুরুত্বহীন। developing বা is developing বসালে পার্ক নিজে বিকশিত হচ্ছে বোঝায়।

q: Never ignore the certainty. (Make it passive)
o: Don't ignore the certainty.
Let the certainty be ignored.
Let be never ignore the certainty.
Let never the certainty be ignored.

q: They will complete the road within six months. [make passive]
o: The road will be completed by them within six months.
The road will have been completed within six months.
The road will be completed six months.
The road would be completed within six months.

q: She will be delivering the speech tomorrow. Change the voice.
o: The speech shall be being deliverd tomorrow.
The speech will be deliver tomorrow.
The speech will be delivering tomorrow.
The speech will be being delivered tomorrow.
e: Active বাক্যটি future continuous tense-এ আছে। এর Passive-এর ছক: will/shall + be + being + V3। এখানে deliver-এর past participle হলো delivered, আর speech হলো নতুন subject, সময়বাচক শব্দ tomorrow আগের মতোই থাকে। তাই সঠিক রূপ The speech will be being delivered tomorrow। অন্য বিকল্পে deliver বা delivering ভুল রূপ, আর শেষটিতে বানান ভুল (deliverd) আছে।
